product.name: CHIMERA LEO 1
product.description: A low Earth orbit (LEO) orbit transfer vehicle designed to deploy and maneuver satellites with a 300 kg payload capacity and 900N hypergolic propulsion.

product.name: CHIMERA LEO BLOCK 0
product.description: A LEO orbit transfer vehicle variant with 295s Isp, 300 kg max payload, and 200 m/s delta-V for apogee kick missions and simple orbital maneuvers.

product.name: CHIMERA LEO BLOCK 1
product.description: A LEO orbit transfer vehicle variant with 295s Isp, 300 kg max payload, and 1000 m/s delta-V for advanced orbital maneuvers including LTAN changes.

product.name: CHIMERA GEO BLOCK 0
product.description: A geosynchronous orbit (GEO) orbit transfer vehicle that moves payloads from GTO to GEO with 310s Isp, 300 kg max payload, and 1800 m/s delta-V.

product.name: CHIMERA GEO BLOCK 0 (BUS)
product.description: A GEO orbit transfer vehicle variant with 310s Isp, 290 kg max payload, station-keeping capabilities, and power options for hosted payloads.

product.name: Propulsion Systems
product.description: Development and manufacturing of propulsion systems using non-toxic hypergolic propellants, including main engines and reaction control thrusters.
